name: Arsenal Mastery
author: rac-rs
description: Ratchet & Clank 3 style weapon levels for Ratchet & Clank 1. Every weapon, and the wrench, earns XP from the damage it deals and grows from V1 to V5 (V8 in New Game+, V99 in Endless); enemies are rebalanced to match. XP is kept per save slot. Needs the rac-rs OmniLoader extension.

settings.name: XP rate
settings.description: How fast weapons earn XP (x1.0 = 10 XP per point of health taken off an enemy).

choices.name: Up Your Arsenal (V5, V8 in New Game+)

settings.name: Enemy rebalance
settings.description: Enemies take less damage the further you are in the game, to match your levelled weapons. Hard adds more; it also costs an extra orb on every second hit, or, with Nanotech levels on, makes enemy hits take 30% more health.

settings.name: Nanotech levels
settings.description: Ratchet & Clank 3 health: you start with 10 health and earn more with every hit you score (+1 a level, up to 100, 200 in New Game+). Enemy hits take more health the further you are in the game. Shown as a number in place of the orbs.

settings.name: Gold version at V5
settings.description: A weapon that has a gold version turns gold at V5.

settings.name: Extra projectiles and perks
settings.description: V3 and V6 add extra behaviour to the weapons.

settings.name: Ammo
settings.description: Survival changes how ammo is found and spent (see the README).

settings.name: XP bars and level-up icons
settings.description: Show each weapon's level and XP bar on the pause menu's Weapons page, and an icon when a weapon levels up.

settings.name: Start every weapon at
settings.description: Sandbox: every weapon is at least this level (V6 and up also opens Mega).

settings.name: Nanotech XP rate
settings.description: How fast you earn nanotech levels (x1.0 = 10/3 nanotech XP per point of health you take off an enemy, a third of the weapon XP). Weapon XP has its own rate.

settings.name: Weapon damage
settings.description: Multiplies the damage your weapons and the wrench deal to enemies, on top of the weapon levels and the enemy rebalance.

settings.name: Damage you take
settings.description: Multiplies the damage enemy hits do to Ratchet. With Nanotech levels: the health a hit takes. Without: x0.5 = every second hit costs no orb, x2 = two orbs a hit.
